headline: Ethereum Glamsterdam Upgrade Risks Breaking Automated Apps
summary: Independent audits revealed compatibility issues in Ethereum's planned Glamsterdam upgrade that could disrupt up to 15,000 automated applications. Core developers are set to reconsider the changes.
why: Ethereum is the primary smart-contract blockchain host for decentralized finance applications and institutional digital asset tokenization.

impacts.name: Ethereum
impacts.why: Compatibility issues in an upcoming protocol upgrade threaten app functionality on Ethereum.
